title: Stir-Fried Peppery Greens
description: A simple and flavorful stir-fry dish packed with peppery greens and a squeeze of fresh lime juice.

ingredients.name: Fresh peppery greens (such as arugula or watercress)
Juicy vegetable oil (such as peanut or canola oil)

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced green onions and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the peppery greens to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
Squeeze the fresh lime juice over the greens and stir-fry for another minute.
Season with salt to taste, if needed.
Serve immediately over rice or noodles, if desired.
